description.value: Straight Line Bicycles is Fernie's only full-service, year-round bike shop and the sole provider of complete in-house suspension overhauls in the Elk Valley. The shop carries a strong roster of brands including Santa Cruz, Transition, Forbidden, and Norco, and employs mechanics specializing in e-bikes, gravel, mountain, and bikepacking. Visiting cyclists can rent full-suspension, gravel, fat, or e-bikes, tap into expert repair services, and even ship a purchased bike home.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is rich and clearly confirms this is an active, full-service year-round bike shop in Fernie with sales, repair, rental, and shipping services. Multiple customer reviews (including one dated August 2025) confirm walk-in urgent repair capability, and the service page explicitly names e-bike specialization. The /shipping/ page confirms bike shipping, and the /rentals/ page confirms a broad rental fleet including e-bikes. No pump or washroom amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service, year-round bike shop in a major BC mountain biking destination, with confirmed rentals, e-bike service, urgent repair capability, and bike shipping. Clear and strong value for touring and visiting cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Note that the mountain and e-bike rental fleet is explicitly not permitted for use at Fernie Alpine Resort — relevant context for cyclists planning lift-accessed riding.

Same-day urgent repairs.detail: Review states 'Awesome service, that saved my day of riding! A crash the night befo[re]...' implying same-day turnaround on crash damage. Another review: 'Best service team in Fernie! Always helpful and will do whatever they can to fix your bike.'

E-bike service.detail: Service page explicitly lists e-bike specialization: 'professional bike mechanics (specializing in e-bikes, gravel, mountain, road, and bikepacking)' and notes additional charges for 'e-Bikes requiring specialized diagnostics or removal of any e-bike-specific components.'

Shipping bikes.detail: Dedicated /shipping/ page: 'FREE shipping on all full price, full suspension, adult mountain bikes within Canada.' Bikes are built, safety-checked, and professionally packed by mechanics before dispatch. US shipping available case-by-case

Bike rentals.detail: Dedicated /rentals/ page: 'Town, Gravel, Trail, Fat & E-Bikes.' Fleet includes full-suspension mountain bikes, gravel, fat bikes (winter-equipped with studded tires and bar mitts), and e-bikes. Helmets included. Seasonal rental program also available on request

wow_evidence: Fernie's only full-service, year-round bike shop and the sole provider of complete in-house suspension overhauls in the Elk Valley
